newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Oil ADRs ease in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Oil ADRs ease in New York.

text.p: Foreign oil companies' American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were mostly lower Monday amid falling oil prices.
"The oil stocks really have had a good run recently and now we're seeing a pullback with the fall in oil prices," a trader said.
Among major oil stocks, Royal Dutch Petroleum Co fell 3/8 to 177-7/8, France's Elf Aquitaine was off 2-1/8 at 49, and British Petroleum Co Plc was off one to 141-1/2.
"When you look at a company like BP, which is up 31 percent since July and is going to report results tomorrow, it's had a pretty good run," the trader said.
Among other European shares, Dutch software company Baan Co NV rose 7/8 to 46-3/8 after Goldman Sachs upgraded the stock.

Swedish telecommunications equipment company LM Ericsson rose 11/16 to 34-1/2 after it increased its forecast for the number of its mobile telephoner users. It was among the most active ADRs in late-morning trade.
Finnish telecommunications equipment maker Nokia Group was up 5/8 to 66-3/8.
Latin American ADRs were mixed in quiet trade. Brazilian bellwether Telebras SA was up 1/2 to 89-1/2.
Advancers led decliners 263 to 209 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 33 million shares in late morning.
